# Section index — every file in this repository, joined to the section it is about

*Generated by `build_section_index.py`. **Do not edit.** This file is a computation, not a
document: it reads the `SEC. n` references already written in the prose and groups them. If a
row here is wrong, the prose is wrong.*

**Why it exists.** The repository is filed by document type — cures in one place, authorities
in another, errata in a third. Every one of them is about some section of the Act, and until
this file nothing joined them. "What has to change in SEC. 6 before v3.5" was an act of memory.
